findings.source_passage: I had no plan, though at that point what I really wanted was a machete and a flashlight. The world of dragons was very dark.
findings.why_it_matters: The opening line's dry comic logic ('I had no plan, though…') is the narrator's signature self-awareness; the draft collapses it to 'I wanted a machete and a flashlight,' losing the setup's ironic rhythm and the aside about the dragon world's darkness.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original opening clause structure: 'I had no plan, though what I really wanted was a machete and a flashlight. The world of dragons was very dark.'

findings.source_passage: Every rock and tree branch tried to murder me, but the sound of the waterfall kept hope alive within me.
findings.why_it_matters: The personification of the environment as homicidal ('tried to murder me') is a comic-voice register marker that appears again with 'last homicidal branch'; the draft reduces this to 'Every root tried to take me down,' losing the escalating comic hyperbole.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'murder me' phrasing and the branch's 'homicidal' modifier; both are small but tonally load-bearing.

findings.source_passage: It was hard to breathe so close to her overpowering aura. 'Isn't that enough?'
findings.source_locator: Exchange at the water's edge, after the Lady cups the narrator's cheek
findings.why_it_matters: The internal tag 'It was hard to breathe so close to her overpowering aura' is character-experience texture establishing the Lady's supernatural presence; the draft omits it entirely, flattening the moment to bare dialogue.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert a beat indicating the narrator's difficulty breathing or the Lady's overwhelming aura before the 'Isn't that enough?' line.

findings.source_passage: Her skin was cold and brushed against mine like the flow of the gentle creek.
findings.source_locator: After 'She cupped my cheek in one of her palms.'
findings.why_it_matters: The simile 'like the flow of the gentle creek' ties the Lady's physicality to her elemental nature; the draft reduces it to 'cold as the brook,' losing the verb ('brushed') and the gentleness qualifier that soften the uncanny moment.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the fuller simile: 'cold and brushed against mine like the flow of the gentle creek.'

findings.source_passage: I threw myself over his chest as he began to shake and thrash. The episode lasted for a long few seconds before a soft blue glow spread from his chest across the rest of his body.
findings.source_locator: Healing scene, after the vial is administered
findings.why_it_matters: The source specifies 'a long few seconds'—a compressed, tense time-marker—and that the glow originates from 'his chest.' The draft compresses the timing and relocates the origin to 'his wounds,' slightly diffusing the precision of the image.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain 'a long few seconds' and 'spread from his chest' to preserve the source's specific choreography.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; three medium-severity findings of voice flattening (opening comic hyperbole, aura interiority, and elemental simile) reduce the narrator's comic-ironic register but do not individually trigger regeneration.
